description: This file manages batch operations for OpenAI embeddings, including submitting batches, fetching status and content, parsing output, error handling, and orchestrating batch runs with retries and polling.

methods.name: submitOpenAiBatch
methods.description: Submits a batch of OpenAI embedding requests, uploads request data, and initiates batch creation.

methods.name: fetchOpenAiBatchStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current status of a specific batch by batch ID.

methods.name: fetchOpenAiFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a file associated with a batch, such as error logs or output.

methods.name: fetchOpenAiBatchResource
methods.description: Generic function to fetch resources related to a batch, handling HTTP response and parsing.

methods.name: parseOpenAiBatchOutput
methods.description: Parses batch output text into structured output lines.

methods.name: readOpenAiBatchError
methods.description: Reads and extracts error messages from a batch error file.

methods.name: waitForOpenAiBatch
methods.description: Polls the batch status until completion, timeout, or failure, with optional debugging.

methods.name: runOpenAiEmbeddingBatches
methods.description: Coordinates the execution of multiple embedding batch groups, handling submission, polling, and output processing.
